layers.edge: optional host/floor nerves — local buffer, sync, degraded local — not this repo name
layers.kernel: this repository — laws, seats, packs, modules, event contracts, computational sensors
layers.office: desk + instance frontend — business decisions, CRM views, send via tools, retro→signal

metaphor.core: backend — shared OS kernel (laws, seats, packs, modules, sensors); Kernel layer, not a nervous-system runtime
metaphor.instance: frontend — one business office that enables modules and binds live tools (Office layer)

events.rule: Disk/checkpoint contracts only — no message broker

instances.note: Create the empty GitHub repo, then run scripts/publish-instance.sh velvet-factory

compat.note: Until the VF instance repo is the Cursor workspace, this core keeps a reference profile so existing desk/STUDIO sensors still pass. Live office front = instances/velvet-factory/.

rule: This repository is VelvetOS Core (backend). Business offices are separate instance repos (frontend) that pull modules from core.
